text:
A venue manager can only see and select
the staff you assign to them. This

tutorial shows how to assign a team, using
fictional demonstration data.

Open Users, then select the Venue managers
tab.

Select View on a venue manager to open
their details.

Open the More menu beside the tabs, and
choose Assigned staff.

This list is everyone the venue manager
can currently see and select in their app.

Select Add Staff. The Select Staff page
lists the staff in your workspace, and

anyone already assigned is marked
Assigned.

Tick the people you want to add, then
select Confirm.

They now appear in the assigned list. To
remove someone, select the cross beside

their name and confirm. Their account and
work history are not deleted.
